components.name: Primary Zine Button
components.description: Tactile yellow primary action button with sketchy ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-zine-primary { background: #fde047; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px 0px #0f172a; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-zine-primary:hover { background: #facc15; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px 0px #0f172a; } .ds-btn-zine-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #0f172a; }

components.name: Secondary Zine Button
components.description: White paper button with sketchy ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-zine-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px 0px #0f172a; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-zine-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px 0px #0f172a; } .ds-btn-zine-secondary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #0f172a; }

components.name: Zine Input Field
components.description: High-contrast text field with ink border.
components.css: .ds-input-zine { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px #0f172a; outline: none; } .ds-input-zine:focus { box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px 0px #0f172a; }

components.name: Zine Card
components.description: White paper container card with hard shadow and sketchy ink outline.
components.css: .ds-card-zine { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; padding: 20px; border: 2px solid #0f172a; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #0f172a; }

narrative.overview: ClassPulse delivers a distinct, highly readable DIY Zine visual style for classroom administration. Moving away from generic dark-mode dashboards and sterile flat UI, ClassPulse presents information as an engaging, hand-drawn explainer publication.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Newsprint Canvas (#faf7f2) with subtle 40px grid dot patterns.
Sketchy Ink Borders (2px solid #0f172a) around containers, buttons, and inputs.
Tactile Zine Drop Shadows (3px to 5px solid offset shadows #0f172a).
Paper Stickers & Tape in highlighter yellow, sky, mint, and pink.
Hand-Drawn Typography pairing Kalam, Architects Daughter, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Hard-Shadow Ink Rule
rules.body: Every card and interactive container must feature a 2px solid #0f172a ink border and a hard offset shadow (3px 3px 0px 0px #0f172a). Soft blurred shadows are strictly prohibited.

rules.name: The Explainer Callout Rule
rules.body: Step-by-step instructions and badges must use monospace or handwriting fonts with dark high-contrast sticker fills.

rules.name: The Tactile Click Rule
rules.body: Buttons and interactive cards must physically shift down and right on active click to flatten their hard offset shadow completely.

dos: Do use 2px solid #0f172a ink borders around cards, tables, inputs, and buttons.
Do use tactile pastel highlighter fills (bg-yellow-200, bg-sky-200, bg-mint-200, bg-pink-200) for step callouts and category cards.
Do maintain high text-to-background contrast and explicit step labels.
donts: Don't use soft ambient blur drop shadows or glassy dark backdrop filters.
Don't use neon glowing gradients or pitch-black dark mode backgrounds.
Don't cram low-level backend telemetry into user-facing admin views.
